statements.impact_statement: This CVE is in containerd's CRI (Container Runtime Interface) checkpoint/restore plugin. oc-mirror-operator depends on github.com/containerd/containerd only transitively, via helm.sh/helm/v3's OCI registry client (pkg/mirror/helm -> helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/repo -> pkg/getter -> pkg/registry -> containerd/containerd/remotes), which uses only generic OCI artifact pull/push primitives for oci:// Helm chart repos. No binary in this project (controller, manager, worker) runs a CRI server, registers a CRI plugin, or performs checkpoint/restore operations, so the vulnerable code path is never reached. No fixed version exists for the github.com/containerd/containerd v1 module line as of triage date; the fix landed only in the unrelated github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 module, which this project does not depend on.

Same reasoning as CVE-2026-53492 in this document: this CVE is in containerd's CRI checkpoint-import path, reachable only through a CRI server. oc-mirror-operator only uses containerd transitively through Helm's generic OCI registry client, and no binary in this project runs a CRI server or performs checkpoint/restore. No fixed version exists for the github.com/containerd/containerd v1 module line as of triage date; the fix landed only in the unrelated github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 module, which this project does not depend on.
